question: Does causally observed deployer launch-count evidence add signal-quality information beyond Participant Quality and existing flow evidence?

feature_contract.definition: max((inner_count + open_count) - 1, 0) from one GMGN created-tokens response whose response_after is no later than the current token 5s decision cutoff
feature_contract.missing_policy: missing stays missing; late/error/rate-limited evidence is never backfilled

acquisition.source: GMGN OpenAPI through gmgn-cli read-only commands

directional_read.next_step_if_sufficient: mechanism/robustness review then define/freeze a separate fresh-confirmation hypothesis
directional_read.next_step_if_insufficient: report insufficient sample; do not extend/repeat based on observed outcome
